invariant: An explicit attached note target is the entity found by quarkInContext(true,idShort), not the unresolved token in the command. A missing target makes the command fail.
causal_divergence: ClassParser stores the short text Cache as Note.target inside a group whose entity id is Polar Harbor.Cache. The renderer adds Graphviz edges using that noncanonical target and cannot find the entity to paint the note attachment. Quoted-code/name grammar also differs from native class note commands.
planned_model_change: Resolve explicit note targets through existing ReuseUnique quark lookup while executing the note command; preserve canonical identity for both single and multiline notes, including quoted codes. Reject unknown explicit targets. Keep shorthand using last_entity_id. Do not alter note layout constants; retain any downstream Opale/cluster failure as nonaccepted residue.
